Your laundromat,
on autopilot.

Keep your coin machines. Add QR payments, loyalty and a live dashboard. Klean collects every payment and pays you daily, so you can focus on your customers.

Open Klean HQ Read the owner's manual
Start in four steps

From sign-up to first scan

1

Get verified

Download Klean, sign in with Apple, Google or GitHub, and verify your identity once (a small fee covers the check).

2

Create your business

In the app: Account → Start a laundromat business. Set your price per load, loyalty rewards and payout account (GCash, Maya or bank).

3

Try it in Beta

Open Klean HQ, add a location and say how many washers and dryers you have. Simulated machines let you test everything with test money.

4

Connect real machines

Fit a Klean controller (buy or build, about ₱1,500–3,000 per machine) and switch Beta off to take real payments.

Everything in one place

  • Live lights: green available, white paid, blue in use, red error
  • Sales reports: daily, weekly, semi-monthly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual
  • Customers: new sign-ups, visits, loyalty ranking, points
  • Attendants: weigh-ins at the counter, "ready for pickup" notices
  • Daily payouts, no subscription; Klean takes a small commission per payment
